# Philips Norelco T970 Accu-Vac Beard and Moustache Trimmer

Keep your beard sharp with a vacuum beard trimmer built for controlled, tidy grooming. The Norelco T970 Accu-Vac pairs precision cutting with an integrated vacuum system to help keep hair out of your sink.

## Precision Trimming for Every Contour

The flexing AccuControl guide comb adapts to your facial shape, so you can reach the neck and chin with ease. Self-sharpening stainless steel blades deliver lasting precision cutting. The zoom lock clicks into nine settings, letting you dial in your preferred beard length and keep it consistent from one trim to the next.

## A Cleaner Grooming Routine

The AccuVac system uses vacuum suction to draw cut hairs into an integrated chamber. Trim at any angle and spend less time sweeping hair off the counter afterward.

## Cord or Cordless, Ready When You Are

This rechargeable moustache and beard trimmer works cordless or plugged in. A one-hour charge time and battery level indicator help you know when it's ready, so you can trim whenever your schedule allows.

## Try It Risk-Free

Backed by a 60-day money-back guarantee, the T970 lets you test it at home with confidence. Order yours today and enjoy a neater, more controlled trim.
